name: ai-status
description: Announces what an AI is doing — thinking, generating, done, failed or stopped — with a shimmering label and an optional Stop button

meta.name: AiStatus
meta.description: Announces what an AI is doing — thinking, generating, done, failed or stopped — with a shimmering label and an optional Stop button

props.name: status
props.description: The phase: `thinking` (working, nothing produced yet), `generating` (output is streaming), `complete`, `error`, or `stopped` (the reader pressed Stop).

props.name: label
props.description: Replaces the default text for the current status, e.g. "Searching 12 documents…".

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n).
props.type: { thinking?: string; generating?: string; complete?: string; error?: string; stopped?: string; stop?: string }

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the reader presses Stop. When set, a Stop button renders while the status is `thinking` or `generating`.

whenToUse: Telling the reader an AI request is in flight, and which phase it is in (thinking before output, generating while it streams)
Offering a keyboard-reachable Stop while a response is being produced
Reporting the terminal outcome of a generation — done, failed or stopped
whenNotToUse: Non-AI async work such as saving a form — use InlineLoading
Holding the place of a chat reply with no text — use TypingIndicator
Determinate progress with a known percentage — use ProgressBar

antiPatterns.bad: aria-live on the streaming response text
antiPatterns.good: <AiStatus status={phase} /> beside the response, which renders silently
antiPatterns.why: A live region on streaming text re-announces on every token; AiStatus announces each phase change once

antiPatterns.bad: Showing AiStatus for a response that arrives in under a second
antiPatterns.good: Delay mounting it ~1s so fast responses never flash a loader
antiPatterns.why: A loader that blinks on and off reads as a glitch and makes a screen reader announce noise

related.name: ShimmerText
related.reason: The in-progress label is rendered in ShimmerText

related.name: InlineLoading
related.reason: InlineLoading is the neutral, non-AI save/submit status

related.name: TypingIndicator
related.reason: TypingIndicator is the wordless placeholder inside a chat bubble

related.name: Reasoning
related.reason: Reasoning shows the model’s thinking while AiStatus reports the phase

intent.a11yRationale: The label lives in a role="status" node holding one stable string per phase, so each phase change is announced once and token-level streaming never is. The glyph is aria-hidden and only it pulses (under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), so the label never drops below contrast. Stop is a real button outside the status node, so pressing it does not re-announce; forced colours render everything CanvasText

content.tone: Present progressive while working ("Thinking…", "Searching the docs…"), terse when done ("Done", "Stopped")
content.notes: Name the specific work when you can; keep it to one line

flexibility.note: Defaults per status come from the i18n catalog; override with label or the labels map
thinking/generating are in progress (sparkle + shimmer); complete/error/stopped are terminal — do not repurpose
